scientific_integrity: The general forward-projection firing law and Sturmian rotation background are credited to the cited literature; novelty is assessed only for the explicit aperiodic two-gap clock classification. Numerical tests are finite diagnostics, not an infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact formula covers irrational 0<alpha<1/2, two positive gaps 0<a<b, and constant classical travel time 0<c<=b after a firing at an opportunity. Does not treat the initial membrane state, travel c>b, or general aperiodic clocks.
title: Sturmian renormalization and a sharp firing-rate jump for aperiodic opportunity clocks
